jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The doctor asks, glancing at the exhausted husband, who stays slumped and stares at the phone in horror. The wife, in the foreground, raises the phone slightly and answers with a sweet satisfied smile, her face clearly visible.
chute: The husband's eye twitches; the doctor slowly puts his pen down. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's sweet satisfied face looking into the camera.

dialogue: Maman, le bébé-là tousse seulement la nuit ?
Oui docteur. Quand son papa rentre du maquis à trois heures dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The doctor asks gently, pen in hand. The father, in the foreground, holds the baby with both arms and does not move. The mother answers sweetly, then slowly turns her head toward her husband, her face clearly visible.
chute: The father freezes with a guilty smile, sweat on his forehead; the doctor raises an eyebrow. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's busted face looking into the camera.
